evals.name: new-module-mantenimientos
evals.prompt: Necesito un módulo de mantenimientos de activos. Cada mantenimiento tiene: descripción (required), costo (decimal, required), fecha (date, required), tipo (enum: PREVENTIVO, CORRECTIVO, GARANTIA), y pertenece a una compañía. Las operaciones son: crear, obtener por ID, y listar por compañía con paginación.
evals.expected_output: Sends a confirmation template, then lists all files across domain → application → infrastructure in the correct order, with correct naming conventions and migration mentioned.

assertions.name: Sends confirmation before writing code
assertions.description: The response sends a structured confirmation message asking the user to verify module details before generating any code

assertions.name: Confirmation covers all 5 required fields
assertions.description: Confirmation message includes: module name, entity fields, operations, authentication, and pagination

assertions.name: Domain files listed before application files
assertions.description: Domain layer files appear before application layer files in the plan

assertions.name: Correct domain file paths
assertions.description: Domain files follow pattern src/domain/mantenimiento|maintenance/entities/, repositories/, use-cases/, exceptions/

assertions.name: Three use case interfaces created
assertions.description: One use case interface per operation: create, get by id, list (3 total)

assertions.name: Migration mentioned
assertions.description: The response mentions generating a TypeORM migration for the new table

assertions.name: References sub-skill files
assertions.description: The response references the sub-skill files (domain-layer/SKILL.md, application/SKILL.md, or infrastructure-layer/SKILL.md) before working on each layer

evals.name: add-field-supplier-website
evals.prompt: Agrega un campo `website` (string, opcional) a la entidad supplier. Debe aparecer en el response DTO y en Swagger.
evals.expected_output: Reads existing supplier files first, identifies all affected layers via impact table (domain entity, mapper, response DTO, DB entity), applies changes domain → application → infrastructure, mentions migration.

assertions.name: Reads existing files before proposing changes
assertions.description: The response explicitly reads or lists the existing supplier files (entity, mapper, DTO, DB entity) before proposing changes

assertions.name: Identifies all affected layers
assertions.description: Identifies that the change affects domain entity, mapper, response DTO, and DB entity (all four)

assertions.name: Applies changes domain first
assertions.description: Domain entity change is proposed before application layer (mapper/DTO) changes

assertions.name: Migration required is called out
assertions.description: Explicitly states that a migration is required because the DB entity changes

assertions.name: Correct TypeScript optional field syntax
assertions.description: The proposed domain entity change uses optional field syntax (website?: string)

evals.name: hybrid-bank-account
evals.prompt: Para el módulo bank-account, necesito agregar un campo `swiftCode` (string, opcional, máx 11 caracteres) Y también un nuevo endpoint para buscar una cuenta bancaria por su número de cuenta.
evals.expected_output: Recognizes this as a hybrid scenario, handles the field addition first (all layers + migration), then adds the new endpoint. Does not interleave the two changes.

assertions.name: Identifies hybrid scenario
assertions.description: The response recognizes or explicitly states that this involves two separate changes (field addition + new endpoint)

assertions.name: Field change handled before new endpoint
assertions.description: The swiftCode field addition is fully addressed before the new search endpoint work begins

assertions.name: Migration called out for field addition
assertions.description: Mentions migration is needed for the swiftCode field

assertions.name: New use case interface for search endpoint
assertions.description: A new use case interface for findByAccountNumber (or similar) is mentioned in the domain layer for the new endpoint

assertions.name: Reads existing bank-account files first
assertions.description: The response reads or lists existing bank-account module files before proposing any changes
